description: Inspect a web page (or targetId) over the debugger protocol: HTML, DOM, console, probes, closed shadow roots. Surfaces by name are extension_dom_snapshot. Firefox: agent bridge, needs allowEval:true.

browser.description: Session browser; required when several run.

deepDom.description: Pierce closed shadow roots; other open roots are not crossed.

probe.description: CSS selectors to count and sample.

projectPath.description: Project root of a running session: extension_dev, extension_start, or `npx extension dev|start` by hand

targetId.description: A page's targetId (extension_open, or dom_snapshot listTargets); overrides url.

url.description: Navigate here first, or the url substring to pick.

name: extension_inspect
